title: Mega-Sena 3050: Check the Drawn Numbers and Prize
seoTitle: Mega-Sena 3050: Drawn Numbers and Prize Announced
subtitle: Thursday's Contest Awarded R$ 23.3 Million with Numbers 11, 14, 30, 38, 49, and 55
excerpt: Caixa Econômica Federal held the Mega-Sena contest 3050 draw on Thursday evening (27).
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Caixa Econômica Federal held the Mega-Sena contest 3050 draw on Thursday evening (27). The main prize, valued at R$ 23,351,895.74, was not claimed by a single winning bet, generating anticipation among bettors following the results.

Numbers Drawn at Espaço da Sorte

The draw took place at Espaço da Sorte, in São Paulo, and determined the six winning numbers of the contest. The drawn numbers were 11, 14, 30, 38, 49, and 55. The order in which they were drawn can influence specific prize tiers, such as Quina or Quadra, if there are winners in these categories.

To check if a bet was a winner, players must compare their six chosen numbers with the official sequence released by the operator. Ticket validation can be done through the Loterias Caixa app or on the Loterias Online portal, where it is possible to enter the bet numbers for immediate verification.

How to Bet on Future Draws

A simple Mega-Sena bet costs R$ 6 and is available for draws held on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Sales close at 8 PM at physical lottery houses, on the Loterias Online portal, and via the Loterias Caixa app. Players must observe this deadline to ensure participation in the scheduled draw.

There is an exception for digital syndicates (bolões digitais), which have a different cut-off time. In these modalities, bets can be purchased until 8:30 PM, exclusively through the Loterias Online portal and the app. This additional window allows more participants to join virtual groups before sales close.

Schedule for Sunday Draws

For contests held on Sundays, the sales schedule is different. Bets can be placed until 10 PM on the Saturday prior to the draw. This extended period allows bettors to plan their participation throughout Saturday evening, without rushing for the closing time.

Digital syndicates for Sunday draws follow their own rules. Bets for these groups close at 10:45 AM on Sunday itself, shortly before the draw begins, which takes place from 11 AM. This time difference requires participants' attention to avoid missing the opportunity to join the virtual syndicates.

Chances of Winning Bets

The chance of winning the main prize varies according to the number of numbers chosen by the bettor. For those who place a simple six-number bet, valued at R$ 6, the probability of winning is one in over 50 million. This statistic reflects the high competition and the difficulty of matching all the numbers.

Those who choose to increase their chances can select seven numbers, a bet that costs R$ 42. In this scenario, the probability of winning increases significantly to one in 7.1 million. The choice between simple or multiple bets depends on each player's budget and strategy to try their luck.

With information from Folha de S.Paulo.
